dialogues.jp: 「ただいま」
dialogues.en: "I'm home."
dialogues.text: "I'm home."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「あ、おかえりなさ〜い。寄り道しないで帰っ
　てきたんだね」
dialogues.en: "Oh, you're home. You came straight home?"
dialogues.text: "Oh, you're home. You came straight home?"

dialogues.jp:
なんだかご機嫌気分な笑顔で、ソファーに座っ
た音夢がひらひらと手を振ってくる。
dialogues.en:
Nemu was sitting on the sofa, and waved her hand to me in
such a good mood.
dialogues.text:
Nemu was sitting on the sofa, and waved her hand to me in
such a good mood.

dialogues.jp: 「お前はまた制服のままテレビ見てるのか？」
dialogues.en: "You're watching TV in your uniform?"
dialogues.text: "You're watching TV in your uniform?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「あははははは」
dialogues.en: "Ha ha."
dialogues.text: "Ha ha."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「笑って誤魔化すなっての」
dialogues.en: "Don't laugh it off."
dialogues.text: "Don't laugh it off."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「だって、着替えているうちに始まっちゃうん
　だもん」
dialogues.en: "Well, the show's starting right now."
dialogues.text: "Well, the show's starting right now."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「この時間は、良いドラマの再放送してくれる
　から嬉しいよねぇ。今度、これの続編がやる
　んだって」
dialogues.en:
"I just love how they rerun the good shows at this time of
the day. They're making the sequel to this soon."
dialogues.text:
"I just love how they rerun the good shows at this time of
the day. They're making the sequel to this soon."

dialogues.jp:
これ、というのは以前やっていた、青春で若く
てコテコテで、おまけに演技の下手なアイドル
が主人公の学園恋愛物だった。
dialogues.en:
The show she's talking about is a school love comedy with an
idol starring in it, who happens to be a bad actor.
dialogues.text:
The show she's talking about is a school love comedy with an
idol starring in it, who happens to be a bad actor.

dialogues.jp:
以前、音夢と一緒に見ていた気がするが、内容
までは覚えていない。
dialogues.en:
I think I've seen the show with Nemu before, but I don't
remember the story.
dialogues.text:
I think I've seen the show with Nemu before, but I don't
remember the story.

dialogues.jp: 「まんまとＴＶ局の罠にはまる女がひとり」
dialogues.en: "Here's a typical example of the network's target audience."
dialogues.text: "Here's a typical example of the network's target audience."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「もぅ、いいじゃない。これだけが楽しみなん
　だから」
dialogues.en: "Leave me alone. This is the only thing I look forward to."
dialogues.text: "Leave me alone. This is the only thing I look forward to."

dialogues.jp:
文句を言いながらも、視線はブラウン管からは
ずれやしない。
dialogues.en: She talked back at me, while staring at the TV.
dialogues.text: She talked back at me, while staring at the TV.

dialogues.jp: 「安上がりなやつ」
dialogues.en: "You're too easy."
dialogues.text: "You're too easy."

dialogues.jp: 音夢の隣に腰掛けてテレビに目を向ける。
dialogues.en: I sat down next to Nemu and looked at the TV.
dialogues.text: I sat down next to Nemu and looked at the TV.

dialogues.jp:
どこにでもありそうな夕暮れの屋上で、制服を
着た男女が向き合っていた。
dialogues.en:
It was a typical situation of a boy and a girl in school
uniforms, on a rooftop at dusk.
dialogues.text:
It was a typical situation of a boy and a girl in school
uniforms, on a rooftop at dusk.

dialogues.speaker: School girl
dialogues.jp:
『ねぇ、神谷くん……先週の日曜日に斎藤先生
　とホテル街を歩いてたのってホント？』
dialogues.en:
""Is it true that you were walking by the hotel with
Saito-sensei last Sunday?""
dialogues.text:
""Is it true that you were walking by the hotel with
Saito-sensei last Sunday?""

dialogues.speaker: School girl
dialogues.jp:
『あの……たまたま先生と会っただけだよ
　ね？』
dialogues.en: ""I suppose you met her coincidentally, right?""
dialogues.text: ""I suppose you met her coincidentally, right?""

dialogues.speaker: Kamiya
dialogues.jp: 『……ごめん』
dialogues.en: "".... I'm sorry.""
dialogues.text: "".... I'm sorry.""

dialogues.speaker: Kamiya
dialogues.jp: 「あ、駄目だこいつ。優柔不断系か？」
dialogues.en: "What an ass. He's totally indecisive."
dialogues.text: "What an ass. He's totally indecisive."

dialogues.jp: 無性に張っ倒したくなるタイプだな。
dialogues.en: I hate this kind of man.
dialogues.text: I hate this kind of man.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「そんなことないよ！」
dialogues.en: "That's not true!"
dialogues.text: "That's not true!"

dialogues.jp: 突然、音夢が拳を握り締めて立ち上がる。
dialogues.en: Nemu stood up suddenly with her fist clenched.
dialogues.text: Nemu stood up suddenly with her fist clenched.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「神谷くんはそう匂わせておいて、あの子のた
　めに先生に色々とされちゃってるんだから！」
dialogues.en:
"It just looks like that, but Kamiya-kun's played by the
teacher because of her!"
dialogues.text:
"It just looks like that, but Kamiya-kun's played by the
teacher because of her!"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「……いや、ドラマの中身くらいで怒るなよ」
dialogues.en: "...Hey, don't get so upset. It's just a TV show."
dialogues.text: "...Hey, don't get so upset. It's just a TV show."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「……ドラマだけどさぁ、こう、手に汗握る展
　開というのか……憧れない？」
dialogues.en:
"I know it's just a TV show. But don't you wish that you
have these moments like that?"
dialogues.text:
"I know it's just a TV show. But don't you wish that you
have these moments like that?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「それを世間一般的に修羅場というのだが、憧
　れるのか？」
dialogues.en: "They call it a living hell, why would you wish for that?"
dialogues.text: "They call it a living hell, why would you wish for that?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「あぅ……そうなんだけどさ。でも、最後がハッ
　ピーエンドならいいでしょ？」
dialogues.en:
"Yeah.... You're right. But if it has a happy ending, then
it should be fine. Don't you think?"
dialogues.text:
"Yeah.... You're right. But if it has a happy ending, then
it should be fine. Don't you think?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「最後がハッピーエンドならな。ところで、ど
　うなるんだっけこの番組は？」
dialogues.en: "If it has a happy ending. How did this show end anyway?"
dialogues.text: "If it has a happy ending. How did this show end anyway?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「えーと、ふたりの仲が良くなって、また校舎
　の屋上でこうやって……」
dialogues.en:
"Let's see. They become close and they end up on the roof
top of the school building again, and then..."
dialogues.text:
"Let's see. They become close and they end up on the roof
top of the school building again, and then..."

dialogues.jp:
場面を再現するように、音夢の手が俺の頬に触
れた。
dialogues.en:
She was trying to act out the scene, and her hand touched my
cheek.
dialogues.text:
She was trying to act out the scene, and her hand touched my
cheek.

dialogues.jp:
間近で音夢の吐息を感じてしまって、思わず鼓
動が早くなる。
dialogues.en:
I felt her breath close to me, and my heart starts to pound
faster.
dialogues.text:
I felt her breath close to me, and my heart starts to pound
faster.

dialogues.jp: 「音夢？」
dialogues.en: "Nemu?"
dialogues.text: "Nemu?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「……あ、あはははは」
dialogues.en: "....Oh. Hahaha..."
dialogues.text: "....Oh. Hahaha..."

dialogues.jp:
ソファーから立ち上がって、音夢が胸を押さえ
て後ずさる。
dialogues.en:
She pressed her chest with her hand and stood up from the
sofa.
dialogues.text:
She pressed her chest with her hand and stood up from the
sofa.

dialogues.jp: 「笑って誤魔化すな」
dialogues.en: "Don't laugh it off."
dialogues.text: "Don't laugh it off."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「ご、ごめんね兄さん。そうだ私、宿題やらな
　くちゃ！」
dialogues.en: "Sorry, I have to go do my homework!"
dialogues.text: "Sorry, I have to go do my homework!"

dialogues.jp:
焦って手をバタバタと振って、音夢が部屋を出
て階段を上っていく。
dialogues.en:
She waved her hand and rushed out of the room to go
upstairs.
dialogues.text:
She waved her hand and rushed out of the room to go
upstairs.

dialogues.en: "Well...."
dialogues.text: "Well...."

dialogues.jp:
音夢に触られた頬をさすりながら、俺はソファー
に深く身体を沈めた。
dialogues.en: I sat down deep in the sofa stroking the cheek Nemu touched.
dialogues.text: I sat down deep in the sofa stroking the cheek Nemu touched.

dialogues.jp:
なんとなく、この雰囲気なら、さくらが来るの
も歓迎出来るかも知れない。
dialogues.en: Maybe we can welcome Sakura now we're in this kind of mood.
dialogues.text: Maybe we can welcome Sakura now we're in this kind of mood.

dialogues.jp: 「あれ？　宿題なんてあったかな？」
dialogues.en: "...Huh? Did we have homework today?"
dialogues.text: "...Huh? Did we have homework today?"

dialogues.jp:
テレビでは、筋書き通りのハッピーエンドを約
束されたふたりが、別れるシーンが流れていた。
dialogues.en:
In the TV show, the man and the woman who supposed to have a
happy ending were leaving each other as I watched.
dialogues.text:
In the TV show, the man and the woman who supposed to have a
happy ending were leaving each other as I watched.

dialogues.jp: ◆ドラマに魅せられて◆
dialogues.en: ◆Being fascinated by a soap opera◆
dialogues.text: ◆Being fascinated by a soap opera◆

dialogues.jp:
居間で、音夢が学園恋愛モノのドラマを見てい
た。
dialogues.en: Nemu was watching a school love comedy show on TV.
dialogues.text: Nemu was watching a school love comedy show on TV.

dialogues.jp:
今後の展開について熱弁を振るう音夢だったが、
勢い余って俺の頬に手を添え、キスの体勢をとっ
てしまう。
dialogues.en:
She was trying to explain what happens next in the show, but
she realized she had her hand over my cheeks which looked
like we were about to kiss.
dialogues.text:
She was trying to explain what happens next in the show, but
she realized she had her hand over my cheeks which looked
like we were about to kiss.

dialogues.jp:
しばらく無言で見詰め合ってしまうふたりだっ
た……。
dialogues.en: We looked at each other silently for a while....
dialogues.text: We looked at each other silently for a while....
